operations.title: Read scope and bind the selected work order
actions: Read the selected goal, material cards, geometry and episode-condition inputs
Bind geometry, specimen allocation, target IDs, repetitions and acceptance observations; identify missing required inputs without replacing them with defaults
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Retrieve identified stock and empty carriers
actions: Read stock labels, material, thickness and lot; choose one allocated item at a time
Grasp packaging or a robust carrier handle, place components in separated cart slots and close retainers
Record remaining stock, issued lot IDs and empty carrier IDs
preconditions: Work order and material identities known
recovery: Wrong or ambiguous material: return or quarantine in original packaging; never relabel it as the requested thickness/material

operations.title: Transport supported objects between stations
actions: Check destination dock availability and the public route; secure carrier contents and retract arms
Navigate the mobile base with the cart, stop at the target dock and engage its brake
Support the carrier while seating it; verify the same object IDs and orientation at the destination
preconditions: Safe path and dock interface available
No object tethered to an active station
recovery: Blocked path: stop and choose another supplied feasible path
Dropped or shifted object: preserve incident, stop transport, inspect and quarantine if integrity cannot be established

operations.title: Lay out parts on the assembly mat
actions: Dock the cart; open only the selected carrier
Support each piece at a supplied robust grasp region, move it into numbered mat recesses and read its identity
Check parts against topology card without assuming every square panel has the same role
preconditions: Required stock and geometry card available
Assembly jig and empty mat ready
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Load sheet stock into the enclosed cutting proxy
actions: Read cardboard/Mylar/elastomer identity and work order
Open the stopped enclosure, support sheet on its specified datum, engage hold-downs and select the supplied pattern
Remove hands, close guard and check interlock
preconditions: Qualified pattern and processing card available
recovery: Wrong pattern/material: unload safely and replace before starting

operations.title: Start and monitor the inert cutting service
actions: Read back pattern revision/material card, start the enclosed inert service and observe completion
Record machine receipt; wait for safe release before opening
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Unload and identify cut parts
actions: Open after safe release; lift the supported sheet/tray and separate cut pieces with the supplied release tool
Place cut pieces in numbered pockets; preserve remainder and reject IDs
Close and reset the empty enclosure
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Load PLA stock and the geometry-specific tray
actions: Read PLA lot and geometry/part manifest; open the stopped printer-proxy enclosure
Seat inert stock and tray at their keyed interfaces, latch and read the selected job
Withdraw hands, close guard and verify interlock
preconditions: Qualified print and geometry cards supplied
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Monitor the inert PLA fabrication service
actions: Read back job and 0.5 mm part-thickness identity before starting
Record service completion and safe-release receipt; do not infer geometry quality from completion alone
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Release printed face pieces into numbered pockets
actions: Open only after safe release; support and remove tray
Use supplied release interface rather than pulling thin features; separate every identified face piece into its pocket
Retain print batch, slot and rejected-part identities
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Inspect part identity, thickness and damage
actions: Carry the numbered tray to the inspection dock
Read material/lot and use the supplied thickness gauge at specified contact regions
Inspect edges, flatness and hinge sheet condition with supplied tolerances; log raw reading and image IDs
Quarantine wrong or damaged pieces before assembly
recovery: Damaged replacement creates a new child ID and rejection record; never silently reuse the rejected identity

operations.title: Align cardboard faces and tape hinges
actions: Place the selected Fig1 geometry pieces into the keyed jig according to its topology card
Support both adjoining face edges, peel the identified tape backing and align the hinge strip without covering motion clearance
preconditions: Accepted 24 mm square, 0.4 mm cardboard parts
Qualified cardboard topology and tape card
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Secure and inspect each tape joint
actions: Press the aligned tape region with the supplied tool while supporting both faces
Check joint attachment, prescribed gap and face movement; repeat for each topology-card joint
Record joint IDs, material parent lots and attachment observations
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Sandwich the hinge sheet between paired PLA parts
actions: Place one identified face half in the jig, align the geometry-specific hinge sheet on its datum, and support its free region
Place the matching face half above it; engage the specified lego-like clamp without substituting adhesive
Check retention and clearance before moving to the next face
preconditions: Accepted printed halves and sheet assigned
Join map and safe clamping interface supplied
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Connect the complete geometry through indexed joints
actions: Maintain external support while joining each face pair at its prescribed hinge connections
Track open joints and face orientations; remove temporary supports only after the supplied support check
Record complete face/hinge/joint graph and sample identity
recovery: Wrong topology: support structure, stop and reverse only the qualified assembly step; repair changes sample version and preserves joint history

operations.title: Verify assembled identity and baseline condition
actions: Support the completed sample in a non-actuating cradle; check its topology against the public card
Measure only prescribed dimensions and capture reference views without forcing a new state
Save specimen ID, geometry, material, version, prior history and baseline observation
preconditions: Assembly complete or qualified preassembled handoff documented
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Inspect the unloaded compression fixture
actions: Ensure motion stopped and read safe state
Inspect clean opposing boundaries, clear travel and supplied alignment datums
Read load-cell identity/calibration and force/displacement sign convention; save unloaded zero check separately
preconditions: Qualified compression fixture and calibration cards
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Align and secure the cuboctahedron
actions: Transport the qualified sample in its carrier and support the specified opposing faces
Align compression axis using supplied fixture datums; secure the fixture without preloading thin hinges beyond the card
Withdraw supports as allowed, check secure seating and save mounted reference images
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Set and read back the displacement program
actions: Bind physical sample L from its qualified card, units and displacement reference
Compute the specified source amplitude sqrt(2)*L only when absolute L is supplied
Enter the supplied physical rate, endpoint, load limits, cycle count and sampling card; independently read back all fields
recovery: Missing physical setting: stop setup and list field; numerical model steps or stiffness ratios cannot fill it

operations.title: Acquire the loading leg of one indexed cycle
actions: Confirm guard, motion clear and condition signature; start the selected cycle
Observe current displacement and force while recording timestamps/units; pause if public load/travel/alignment limits fail
Save raw loading leg with cycle index and start/end state
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Acquire unloading and endpoint evidence
actions: Return under the supplied displacement-control program while continuing raw acquisition
Observe release-path and endpoint feedback without reaching into moving fixture
Save unload leg, endpoint state and cycle validity together with the loading record
preconditions: Corresponding loading leg exists or aborted leg documented
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Continue the declared cycle plan without deleting failures
actions: Preserve chronological cycle numbering including aborted cycles
Recheck unchanged material/mount/condition signature before each cycle
Repeat loading and unloading through the episode count; any fixture or settings change starts a new run
preconditions: At least one indexed cycle attempted
recovery: Interrupted cycle remains invalid; retry uses a fresh cycle/attempt ID and cannot replace the interrupted record

operations.title: Unload the specimen after verified stop
actions: Stop motion and acquisition, confirm safe release and support the sample
Release clamps in supplied order, lift along the clearance path and seat it in its original carrier
Inspect residual shape/damage and save post-test condition
preconditions: All requested cycles attempted or run aborted with reason
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Summarize the actual last five cycles
actions: Select the chronologically final five cycles of the completed declared run, retaining their IDs
Require five complete paired loading/unloading records with the same condition signature; if any is invalid report incomplete rather than choose five older successes
Apply supplied alignment/interpolation and standard-deviation convention separately to loading and unloading; retain raw data and processing version
Describe force sign and hysteresis observations without forcing paper values
preconditions: Five final valid cycles present for a complete summary
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Register a target and its pre-attempt state
actions: Read opaque target ID and available target geometry/view card
Seat specimen on the non-actuating support and record actual starting shape, specimen version, material and prior attempts
Bind the supplied action/contact card; do not infer a complete actuation path from a photograph
preconditions: Target and qualified contact/support card available
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Apply bounded local manipulation with support
actions: Position base and both hands at supplied contact regions; support the body while actuating only the selected hinge/face regions
Follow the supplied incremental displacement/contact card and monitor visible force/stretch/clearance feedback
Stop at the target observation or at the first supplied physical limit; never push non-adjacent faces through each other
recovery: Stretch limit/contact obstruction: stop and record limit-constrained/unreachable for this attempt; do not increase limits to chase a simulated state

operations.title: Remove actuation and verify unsupported observation
actions: Reduce external actuation under the public release card while keeping only non-actuating support
Withdraw actuating contacts and record applied-load-off feedback and release timestamp
Do not count a pose held by a robot finger or fixture as an unloaded stable configuration
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Observe relaxation under a declared window
actions: Without transporting or regrasping during the observation window, capture the released state at card-defined times/views
Compare loaded target and final observed geometry with the supplied classification rule
Separate reached_while_loaded, retained_after_release, relaxed_to_other, returned_baseline, limit_constrained, damaged and indeterminate
preconditions: Public observation and geometry rules supplied
recovery: Occluded or too-short observation: retain indeterminate; repeat observation under a new record rather than declaring stability

operations.title: Prepare the next attempt without erasing history
actions: Check the observed final state and specimen integrity
Use only a supplied safe reset path to a recorded starting state; if unavailable or damage persists, stop or request an allocated replacement
Record reset completion and new starting image; retain previous attempt including relaxation/failure
recovery: No qualified reset: archive current shape and mark remaining targets blocked; a replacement has a new sample ID and distinct replicate status

operations.title: Compare targets and release outcomes honestly
actions: Compile every scheduled target/attempt with source target label and independent observed loaded/released state
Record missing, unreachable, relaxed and damaged attempts alongside retained states
Compare with the source only as a cited contextual reference; keep Fig4 text/pixel label disagreement explicit
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Change cube hinge material with traceable identity
actions: Choose the work-order-approved separate matched cube or supported hinge-replacement route
For replacement, stop actuation, support the full cube, remove identified old hinges to an archive tray and record every parent/child connection
Install identified 0.5 mm elastomeric hinges using a supplied attachment card; reinspect baseline and assign a new sample version
Never change the material label on the existing Mylar configuration
preconditions: Replacement material and join card available
recovery: Torn sheet or altered faces: quarantine and flag comparison as unmatched; do not merge separate-specimen and within-specimen histories

operations.title: Compare the two cube hinge conditions
actions: Require material-specific target attempts for all planned eight target labels
Match geometry/start-state/actuation cards and report unmatched factors
Report retained, relaxed, limit-constrained and crossing-blocked outcomes by material without using source success counts as rewards
preconditions: Both material-condition datasets available or precise blockers
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Bind finite-array units and eight cell slots
actions: Read finite 2x2x2 topology card, unit IDs and array hinge thickness condition
Lay out units and intercell joints with slot coordinates (0 or 1 on each axis)
Inspect each unit and retain unit-to-array ancestry; never use one physical ID in multiple slots
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Assemble and inspect intercell connections
actions: Support neighboring units in the supplied jig and join each designated intercell hinge in the supplied sequence
Check each slot, interface and orientation; record completed joints before removing temporary supports
Transport the array in a multi-point support carrier, never by one boundary cell
preconditions: Join map and fixture support available
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Record bulk, boundary and longer-period observations
actions: Bind each attempt to a supplied target class: bulk-compatible, edge/corner or longer-than-one-cell periodicity
Record which cell slots changed and which boundary contacts/supports were present
Keep finite-array evidence distinct from periodic single-cell numerical predictions
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Compare 50 and 125 micrometre arrays
actions: Require separately identified 50 and 125 micrometre Mylar assemblies and condition-specific attempt histories
Match geometry/target/start-state protocols where explicitly supplied; list unresolved confounders
Report additional-state retention or lack of retention over attempted scope, not universal impossibility
preconditions: Both thickness conditions attempted or blocked explicitly
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Receive or construct the qualified SI6 specimen
actions: Read supplied material/fabrication/geometry card for truncated cube or rhombicuboctahedron

If manufacturing inputs exist, route through their declared preparation/assembly operations; otherwise receive a qualified preassembled teaching object with an explicit outside-scope fabrication receipt
Preserve material unknowns from the source and do not infer PLA/Mylar from appearance
preconditions: Explicit specimen route and identity card supplied
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Match SI6 selected model/physical configuration pairs
actions: Use the 11 truncated-cube or 15 rhombicuboctahedron displayed labels as requested target inventory
Save actual views and release observations paired with the target-view card; mark ambiguous matches indeterminate
Do not claim these selected displays enumerate all states or imply one independent specimen per picture
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Prepare the text-reported two-pouch branch
actions: Bind a qualified truncated-tetrahedron specimen, two individually identified inert pouch proxies and attachment/channel diagram
Support the structure while seating the pouches at the supplied hinge locations
Record attachments and strain relief; actual pouch construction remains a required external card
preconditions: Pneumatic qualified geometry and attachment card available
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Connect and verify stopped pneumatic interfaces
actions: Read channel A/B labels; verify source off, residual-pressure-safe feedback and regulator limit card
Connect each specified tube to its keyed port, secure strain relief and check the supplied leak-test/feedback contract
Record port graph and independent channel feedback
recovery: Leak or swapped labels: keep source off, vent under supplied card, reseat and recheck; no pressure escalation

operations.title: Read back a supplied discrete actuation program
actions: Read one episode-supplied pouch command sequence with timing, pressure, hold and vent settings
Verify its target ID and start-state card without assuming a one-to-one mapping from four Boolean commands to four stable states
Confirm channel mapping and record the program signature
preconditions: Complete qualified program and safety inputs
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Execute one bounded pouch attempt
actions: Clear hands from moving regions and use physical proxy controls to start the supplied program
Record channel command/readback, timing, loaded state and limit feedback
Stop on a failed readback or public limit; retain the attempt and reason
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Remove actuation and record relaxation
actions: Stop the supply and vent using supplied controls; verify both channel readbacks safe
Capture load-off timestamp and unloaded-state observations over the supplied window
Distinguish held inflation shape from retained configuration
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Disconnect and archive the pouch setup safely
actions: Verify pressure-safe feedback on both channels before handling connections
Support and disconnect tubing, dock ends and carrier; archive pouch attachment history and specimen state
Leave source off and station reset
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Report only the observed pneumatic scope
actions: Compile all planned program attempts and load-off observations with channel and condition signatures
Cite the source text reporting two pouches/four states separately from the episode records
When target mapping or pressure/timing inputs are missing report the branch blocked, not four successful states
preconditions: Pneumatic records or explicit missing-input list
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Isolate a damaged or ambiguous specimen
actions: Stop and release/vent station using its qualified safe contract
Support the object into a labeled quarantine carrier and attach failure/attempt IDs
Record location, irreversibility and remaining branch impact
preconditions: Public damage, mismatch, unsafe state or uncertain identity observed
recovery: If safe release is unavailable, isolate station and request intervention without reaching into an unsafe fixture

operations.title: Archive samples, components and immutable raw records
actions: Check one physical location for every sample, unit, removed hinge and rejected part
Place each supported carrier in its assigned archive slot with current version and history
Save append-only raw records, condition cards, target/cycle coverage and derived links
preconditions: Selected work concluded or precise stop status known
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Return tools and verify stopped empty workstations
actions: Verify compression motion/acquisition off and pneumatic supply/residual pressure safe when selected
Dock tools, return unused stock, account for offcuts/backings and clear empty jigs
Record final station checks; do not restore specimens to fictitious pristine states
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

operations.title: Submit bounded completion and remaining gaps
actions: Link source-supported conditions, authored task inputs, actual records and final identities
Declare complete, partial_with_valid_blocker, safe_abort or failed for each selected branch
Separate procedural success from scientific agreement and list unattempted/invalid conditions
preconditions: Selected branch evidence and final status known
recovery: Stop the affected action; retain attempt and current object state; inspect available public feedback and resume only after required conditions are verified

template_dependency_semantics: depends_on lists partial-order prerequisites for an occurrence, not a fixed actor script; family expansions add data bindings and move events. Repetition creates fresh occurrence IDs, not cycles in this template DAG. Alternative source-gap handoffs are explicit in branches.
station_change_rule: Insert MOVE for every physical station change, including backtracking and replacements; WS_INSPECTION during OBSERVE denotes a co-located camera/inspection role, with no sample transport during relaxation observation.
